headline: $30,000 state recycling grant for education and food waste reduction approved.
summary: Money from the Mass DEP recycling dividends fund will pay for programs to cut contamination in recycling and food waste in trash. A separate $300,000 grant needs council approval and an ordinance change, and it is not on tonight's agenda. The $60,000 Blue Cross Blue Shield grant and two fire safety education grants were also approved.
decisions: Approved fire safety education grants for students and seniors.
Approved spending $60,000 from the Blue Cross Blue Shield OB3 Defense Grant to help residents who lose health insurance.
Approved spending $30,000 from the Mass DEP recycling dividends fund on recycling and waste reduction programs.
discussion: Recycling contamination: Members asked whether the grant could pay for enforcement as well as education. A presenter said it could fund tags on contaminated barrels, but $30,000 would not pay for much staff time.
Health insurance grant: Members asked who the grant would help. The presenter said trained former contact tracers would do outreach across the 13 communities in the Montageuse Public Health Network.

decision_evidence.quote: Okay. All right, we have a motion to accept orders 193-26 and order 194-26 together. Seeing no objections, it is unanimously approved.
